Definition
[Pointwise inner product of tensors]

Source: petersen:page-0050 ↗ def:pet-ch1-euclidean-norm

Given an orthonormal frame $E_i$ and its dual coframe $\sigma ^i$, declare \[ E_{i_1}\otimes \cdots \otimes E_{i_s}\otimes \sigma ^{j_1}\otimes \cdots \otimes \sigma ^{j_t} \] to be an orthonormal basis of the $(s,t)$-tensors. This determines their pointwise inner product and extends $g(X,Y)$ for vector fields.
